title: Failing test if the feed logic is wrong, then the fix
goal: The feed e2e test is reliable on CI
acceptance: If the feed logic is at fault, a test committed failing first shows it and the fix makes it pass
The test passes 30 times under load and on the next 10 CI runs
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 by the delivery audit; depends on what B-008-T01 finds.
